scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run openapi:check && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run format:check
scripts.lint:py: python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:e2e
